exposure: history of secondary infertility and multiple spontaneous miscarriages
outcome: prevention of repeated midtrimester pregnancy losses
absence of intraoperative complications from TAC
cohort: A 28-year-old woman with secondary infertility and a bicornuate uterus who experienced multiple spontaneous miscarriages despite previous cervical stitches.
finding: Laparoscopic transabdominal cervical cerclage (TAC) appears safe and effective in preventing repeated midtrimester pregnancy losses for patients with a bicornuate uterus.
